headline: SEBI Prepares Paper to Ease Foreign Portfolio Investment Rules in India
summary: The Securities and Exchange Board of India plans to issue a consultation paper aimed at easing regulatory requirements for foreign portfolio investors to attract international capital into domestic markets.
why: SEBI is India's capital markets regulator, enforcing rules for foreign institutional investment into Indian listed equities and bonds.

impacts.name: India
impacts.why: Easing regulatory entry hurdles simplifies international capital deployment into Indian financial markets.
